title: Valuation (derived portfolio total)
description: A DERIVED snapshot of what the portfolio is worth. Every figure is an exact decimal string and 'never 0 standing in for unknown' (finance/portfolio doc): a holding with no known price is nil/absent, and the total is computed from the priced subset only - it never silently acquires a zero contribution from an unpriceable asset. `as_of` is the SERVER's clock at derivation time (AsOf: time.Now().UnixMilli() inside Derive), which makes the derivation clock-dependent and therefore not reproducible without an injected clock.

total_value_usd.description: Null when nothing could be priced - never '0'.

as_of.description: Server clock at derivation; a recorded_at in meaning, an observed_at in name. See canonical-model.md T6.

holdings.description: The priced rows the total was built from, so a consumer can show its work.

quantity.description: Exact NON-NEGATIVE decimal string (the Go derivation refuses a negative quantity with a field-named error).
